scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w database && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p database/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w database && npm run db:migrate -w database
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w database && npm run db:seed -w database
